tickets.title: Prepare pre-clearance narrative for Selene Velvetreed’s proposed sale
tickets.text: Prepare a pre-clearance narrative for Selene Velvetreed’s proposed sale covering the proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and confirmation that no material nonpublic information is involved. The narrative is for Apricot Compass Advisory’s review.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to prepare pre-clearance narrative covering proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and no material nonpublic information to Apricot Compass Advisory.

tickets.title: Prepare before-tax exercise cost and cash-needed scenarios
tickets.text: Prepare before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios for Selene Velvetreed’s vested nonqualified stock options. The options expire soon after the next blackout window.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-11 to provide before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios because vested options expire soon after the next blackout window.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody’s share feed with the employer report
